# ASP.NET Core templates

Use these templates as stack-specific starting points alongside the common [template catalog](../../../../docs/templates/README.md). Copy the template into the target project's `docs/` area, remove prompts that do not apply, and verify all assumptions against the solution, source, configuration, and deployment setup.

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [Feature specification](spec.md) | Capture API, domain, persistence, and operational contracts for a change. |
| [Verification plan](verification-plan.md) | Plan .NET build, test, persistence, API, security, and migration evidence. |
| [Threat-model prompts](threat-model-prompts.md) | Add ASP.NET Core-specific trust boundaries and threat questions to the common threat model. |
